name: MKI Seerr Bridge
overview: Seerr inside Jellyfin: button, embedded view, search and sign-in.
description: Brings Seerr into the Jellyfin web client: a button in the header and side menu, Seerr embedded in Jellyfin instead of a redirect, Seerr suggestions under Jellyfin search results with one-click requests attributed to the right user, optional single sign-on via Quick Connect, and a compatibility bridge for clients that still send legacy X-Emby authorization headers.
changelog: New settings page in the shared MKI design, with tabs for Connection, Menu & search and Sign-in. A diagram shows both roads to Seerr and whether each one answers, a connection test runs by itself after an address change, and the page warns about address problems such as mixed http and https. A sketch shows where the Requests button lands, and Try a search previews the suggestions. Settings save as soon as you change them, with undo; changes that affect requests or sign-in ask first. Works on phones and in light and dark themes.
